title: Set system keyboard layout
summary: Change the keyboard layout used for the console and graphical sessions.

steps.explain: Set the system keyboard mapping to a specific layout. You usually need root privileges for this.

placeholders.name: KEYMAP
placeholders.description: The name of the keyboard layout to use, e.g., us, de, ru.

rollback.explain: To revert, set the keymap back to its previous value using the same command.

placeholders.name: PREVIOUS_KEYMAP
placeholders.description: The keyboard layout name it had before you changed it.

warnings: Changing the keymap affects how keys are interpreted in the console and some graphical environments.
If you set a layout you don't know, you might have trouble typing passwords or commands until you revert it.
